example.name: archived
example.source: Example 1. Client receives a message that has been archived

examples.example: <message to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony' from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard' type='chat'> <body>Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized; Henceforth I never will be Romeo.</body> <stanza-id xmlns='urn:xmpp:sid:0' by='juliet@capulet.lit' id='28482-98726-73623' /> </message>

example.name: query
example.source: Example 2. A user queries their archive for messages

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='f27' /> </iq>

example.name: result
example.source: Example 3. Their server sends the matching messages

examples.example: <message id='aeb213' to='juliet@capulet.lit/chamber'> <result xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='f27' id='28482-98726-73623'> <forwarded xmlns='urn:xmpp:forward:0'> <delay xmlns='urn:xmpp:delay' stamp='2010-07-10T23:08:25Z'/> <message xmlns='jabber:client' from="witch@shakespeare.lit" to="macbeth@shakespeare.lit"> <body>Hail to thee</body> </message> </forwarded> </result> </message>

example.name: fin
example.source: Example 4. Server returns the result IQ to signal the end

examples.example: <iq type='result' id='juliet1'> <fin xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <set xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/rsm'> <first index='0'>28482-98726-73623</first> <last>09af3-cc343-b409f</last> </set> </fin> </iq>

example.name: query-service
example.source: Example 5. A user queries an archive for messages

examples.example: <iq to='pubsub.shakespeare.lit' type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='f28' /> </iq>

example.name: query-with
example.source: Example 6. Querying for all messages to/from a particular JID

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'> <value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value> </field> <field var='with'> <value>juliet@capulet.lit</value> </field> </x> </query> </iq>

example.name: query-after-id
example.source: Example 9. Querying the archive for all messages after a certain message

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'> <value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value> </field> <field var='after-id'> <value>09af3-cc343-b409f</value> </field> </x> </query> </iq>

example.name: query-between
example.source: Example 10. Querying the archive for all messages between two known messages

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'> <value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value> </field> <field var='after-id'> <value>28482-98726-73623</value> </field> <field var='before-id'> <value>09af3-cc343-b409f</value> </field> </x> </query> </iq>

example.name: query-ids
example.source: Example 11. Fetching a specific message from the archive

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'> <value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value> </field> <field var='ids'> <value>28482-98726-73623</value> </field> </x> </query> </iq>

example.name: query-exclude-groupchat
example.source: Example 13. Querying the archive and excluding groupchat messages from results

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='juliet1'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'> <value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value> </field> <field var='include-groupchat'> <value>false</value> </field> ... </x> </query> </iq>

example.name: two-results
example.source: Example 17. Server returns two matching messages

examples.example:
<message id='aeb213' to='juliet@capulet.lit/chamber'> <result xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='f27' id='28482-98726-73623'> <forwarded xmlns='urn:xmpp:forward:0'> <delay xmlns='urn:xmpp:delay' stamp='2010-07-10T23:08:25Z'/> <message xmlns='jabber:client' to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony' from='romeo@montague.lit/orchard' type='chat'> <body>Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized; Henceforth I never will be Romeo.</body> </message> </forwarded> </result> </message>
<message id='aeb214' to='juliet@capulet.lit/chamber'> <result xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='f27' id='5d398-28273-f7382'> <forwarded xmlns='urn:xmpp:forward:0'> <delay xmlns='urn:xmpp:delay' stamp='2010-07-10T23:09:32Z'/> <message xmlns='jabber:client' to='romeo@montague.lit/orchard' from='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony' type='chat' id='8a54s'> <body>What man art thou that thus bescreen'd in night so stumblest on my counsel?</body> </message> </forwarded> </result> </message>

example.name: query-rsm
example.source: Example 18. A query using Result Set Management

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='q29302'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'> <value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value> </field> <field var='start'> <value>2010-08-07T00:00:00Z</value> </field> </x> <set xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/rsm'> <max>10</max> </set> </query> </iq>

example.name: fin-rsm
example.source: Example 19. Server responds to client with limited results using RSM

examples.example: <!-- result messages --> <iq type='result' id='q29302'> <fin xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <set xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/rsm'> <first index='0'>28482-98726-73623</first> <last>09af3-cc343-b409f</last> <count>20</count> </set> </fin> </iq>

example.name: query-page
example.source: Example 20. A page query using Result Set Management

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='q29303'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'><value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value></field> <field var='start'><value>2010-08-07T00:00:00Z</value></field> </x> <set xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/rsm'> <max>10</max> <after>09af3-cc343-b409f</after> </set> </query> </iq>

example.name: id-not-found
example.source: Example 21. Message id not found in archive

examples.example: <iq type='error' id='q29303'> <error type='cancel'> <item-not-found xmlns='urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:xmpp-stanzas'/> </error> </iq>

example.name: fin-complete
example.source: Example 22. Server completes a result with the last page of messages

examples.example: <!-- result messages --> <iq type='result' id='u29303'> <fin xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' complete='true'> <set xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/rsm'> <first index='0'>23452-4534-1</first> <last>390-2342-22</last> <count>16</count> </set> </fin> </iq>

example.name: query-last-page
example.source: Example 23. A request for the last page in an archive

examples.example: <iq type='set' id='q29303'> <query xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <x xmlns='jabber:x:data' type='submit'> <field var='FORM_TYPE' type='hidden'><value>urn:xmpp:mam:2</value></field> <field var='start'><value>2010-08-07T00:00:00Z</value></field> </x> <set xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/rsm'> <max>10</max> <before/> </set> </query> </iq>

example.name: metadata-request
example.source: Example 25. Requesting archive metadata

examples.example: <iq type='get' id='jui8921rr9'> <metadata xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'/> </iq>

example.name: metadata-result
example.source: Example 26. Server returns archive metadata

examples.example: <iq type='result' id='jui8921rr9'> <metadata xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2'> <start id='YWxwaGEg' timestamp='2008-08-22T21:09:04Z' /> <end id='b21lZ2Eg' timestamp='2020-04-20T14:34:21Z' /> </metadata> </iq>

example.name: muc-results
example.source: Example 27. Server returns MUC messages

examples.example:
<message id='iasd207' from='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit' to='hag66@shakespeare.lit/pda'> <result xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='g27' id='78527-06716-51603'> <forwarded xmlns='urn:xmpp:forward:0'> <delay xmlns='urn:xmpp:delay' stamp='2002-10-13T23:58:37Z'/> <message xmlns="jabber:client" from='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit/firstwitch' id='162BEBB1-F6DB-4D9A-9BD8-CFDCC801A0B2' type='groupchat'> <body>Thrice the brinded cat hath mew'd.</body> <x xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/muc#user'> <item affiliation='owner' jid='crone1@shakespeare.lit' role='participant' /> </x> </message> </forwarded> </result> </message>
<message id='iasd207' from='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit' to='hag66@shakespeare.lit/pda'> <result xmlns='urn:xmpp:mam:2' queryid='g27' id='34482-21985-73620'> <forwarded xmlns='urn:xmpp:forward:0'> <delay xmlns='urn:xmpp:delay' stamp='2002-10-13T23:58:43Z'/> <message xmlns="jabber:client" from='coven@chat.shakespeare.lit/secondwitch' id='90057840-30FD-4141-AA44-103EEDF218FC' type='groupchat'> <body>Thrice and once the hedge-pig whined.</body> <x xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/muc#user'> <item affiliation='admin' jid='wiccarocks@shakespeare.lit' role='participant' /> </x> </message> </forwarded> </result> </message>

example.name: features
example.source: Example 29. Server responds with features

examples.example: <iq type='result' id='disco1' from='juliet@capulet.lit' to='juliet@capulet.lit/balcony'> <query xmlns='http://jabber.org/protocol/disco#info'> ... <feature var='urn:xmpp:mam:2'/> <feature var='urn:xmpp:mam:2#extended'/> ... </query> </iq>
